label: shared read
detail: Polled every 300 ms by default; the file is never written, locked or renamed.

label: insert
detail: Committed as a row before anything parses it.

label: raw rows
detail: Read in sequence order, inside the capture process.

label: replace
detail: A match's derived rows are replaced together.

label: read-only
detail: A separate process polls for new rows every 250 ms.

label: read-only
detail: The 15 tools share one handle opened with SQLite's read-only flag.

label: at start
detail: Never waited for: one attempt to apply view definitions and, unless disabled, a second to catch up on the log; each is skipped if another writer holds the lock.

label: stdio
detail: JSON-RPC over stdio; logs go to stderr.
Never waited for. Capture holds it for its whole run; one-shot commands (ingest, rebuild, card load) take it one at a time.
